{{Quote|The Gormak have taken up position near Pelath Point. It's one of the surviving research camps, a neutral Voss outpost.|Halykus|<ref name="Better Left Buried" />}}
'''Pelath Point''' was a hill on the [[Pel-Ki Ridge]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Pelath Point was the site of [[Pir-Tel Outpost]], a [[Voss commando]] outpost built around an ancient ruin.<ref name="Better Left Buried" />
